A Versatile Teleoperation framework for Robotic Manipulation using Meta Quest3

# OPEN TEACH: A Versatile Teleoperation System for Robotic Manipulation ##### Authors: Aadhithya Iyer ,Zhuoran Peng, Yinlong Dai, Irmak Guzey, Siddhant Haldar, Soumith Chintala, Lerrel Pinto [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07870) [Website](https://open-teach.github.io/) This is the official implementation of the Open Teach including unity scripts for the VR application, teleoperation pipeline and demonstration collection pipeline. Open Teach consists of two parts. - [x] Teleoperation using Meta Quest 3 and data collection over a range of robot morphologies and simulation environments. - [x] Policy training for various dexterous manipulation tasks across different robots and simulations. ### VR Code and User Interface Read VR specific information, User Interface and APK files [here](/docs/vr.md) ### Server Code Installation Install the conda environment from the yaml file in the codebase **Allegro Sim** `conda env create -f env_isaac.yml` **Others** `conda env create -f environment.yml` This will install all the dependencies required for the server code. After installing all the prerequisites, you can install this pipeline as a package with pip: `pip install -e . ` You can test if it had installed correctly by running ` import openteach` from the python shell. ### Robot Controller Installation Specific Information 1. For Simulation specific information, follow the instructions [here](/docs/simulation.md). 2. For Robot controller installation, follow the instructions [here](https://github.com/NYU-robot-learning/OpenTeach-Controllers) ### For starting the camera sensors For starting the camera sensors and streaming them inside the screen in the oculus refer [here](/docs/sensors.md) ### Running the Teleoperation and Data Collection For information on running the teleoperation and data collection refer [here](/docs/teleop_data_collect.md). ### Policy Learning For open-source code of the policies we trained on the robots refer [here](/docs/policy_learning.md) ### Polic

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：Open-Teach 基于 Meta Quest 3 的手部追踪能力构建遥操作流水线：通过 VR 端手部姿态估计与 Unity 脚本，将人手动作实时重定向到不同机器人本体（Franka、xArm、WidowX、Allegro Hand 等）及多套仿真环境（MuJoCo/IsaacGym），并配套相机流传输、示教数据采集与策略训练（ACT、Diffusion Policy 等模仿学习）的完整开源 pipeline。


# 一、动机

> 现有机器人遥操作方案（如 iPhone/iOS 应用、动捕手套、专用主手）往往受限于成本高、需多摄像头标定、只适配单一机器人本体或难以迁移到仿真环境；缺少一种低成本、跨本体、开箱即用的通用遥操作与数据采集框架。


# 二、方法

> Open-Teach 基于 Meta Quest 3 的手部追踪能力构建遥操作流水线：通过 VR 端手部姿态估计与 Unity 脚本，将人手动作实时重定向到不同机器人本体（Franka、xArm、WidowX、Allegro Hand 等）及多套仿真环境（MuJoCo/IsaacGym），并配套相机流传输、示教数据采集与策略训练（ACT、Diffusion Policy 等模仿学习）的完整开源 pipeline。


# 三、核心实验结果

> （1）在 5 种以上机器人本体和多个仿真环境中验证了同一套系统无需改动即可完成遥操作与示教采集；（2）相比基于 iPhone 的遥操作基线，数据采集速度约提升 2 倍，端到端延迟控制在亚秒级；（3）用 Open-Teach 采集的数据训练的模仿学习策略在真实与仿真灵巧操作任务上成功率约为基线的 1.5 倍左右，且整套硬件成本仅约 500 美元。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：依赖 VR 头显内向外手部追踪精度、缺少力/触觉反馈，对强接触、精细力控任务（如插拔、拧螺丝）仍有困难，且单视角观测限制了遮挡场景。启发：把廉价消费级 VR 设备当作具身数据采集入口，能以极低成本跨本体、跨仿真扩展示教数据规模，对遥操作与数据规模化收集很有参考价值。
